page-title.purpose: Chinese category heading outside the scroll area.

body.purpose: Settings text and sidebar category labels.

supporting.purpose: Page purpose, system notes and secondary descriptions.

caption.purpose: Units, scope, recovery notes and metric labels.

metric.purpose: Preview values with native monospacedDigit treatment.

native.platformEnumSupport: macOS is outside the plugin web/iOS/Android enum; it is deliberately not recast as another platform.
native.coordinates: macOS logical points; CSS pt is not a renderer specification for this app.
native.fontFamilySource: SwiftUI Font.system; frontmatter system-ui is a portable semantic label.

accent.purpose: Subtle selected navigation tint, chosen controls, preview focus

primary-text.purpose: Titles, labels, values and geometry outlines.

supporting-text.purpose: Descriptions, units, scope and status explanations.

control-surface.purpose: Main settings content and preview bar

permission-granted.purpose: Permission granted, paired with a checkmark and textual state.

material.purpose: Quiet settings sidebar; main content uses controlBackgroundColor

layout.customSizingBehavior: Five fixed sample apps respond to size, unified spacing, length and position above the controls on horizontal edges or beside them on vertical edges; no live-row mirroring.

componentRendering.htmlCssSnippets: Intentionally empty: native SwiftUI/AppKit controls and materials are not HTML/CSS components. The sidecar does not claim web panel fidelity.
componentRendering.colorSerialization: Native semantic selectors are authoritative. No approximate CSS palette or synthesized tonal ramps are introduced.
componentRendering.detectorApplicability: No HTML/CSS detector result is applicable to these native source files.

evidence.captureMethod: WindowServer captures of owned inactive fixture windows with synthetic data, never physical-mouse acceptance.
evidence.assetChanges: Existing app icon and slogan retained; no generated raster assets.
evidence.documentationPassScope: Updated against current source behavior; fresh native screenshot/release acceptance is recorded separately.
evidence.verificationLimits: Do not infer physical mouse, VoiceOver, clean-machine installation or actual-login acceptance from fixtures and injected services.

spacingModel.zero: Adjacent visible artwork bounding boxes meet along the ordering axis.
spacingModel.hundred: Gap equals the mean adjacent visible dimension along the ordering axis.
spacingModel.bitmapPolicy: Keep original square drawing canvas, bitmap scale, aspect and pixels; cached artwork bounds drive layout and hit ownership.
spacingModel.legacyPolicy: Opening settings preserves legacy geometry; explicit spacing/preset/reset choices enter the new path.
spacingModel.overflowPolicy: Preserve the percentage; optional shrinking scales the optical row, then scrolls if needed. No silent gap compression.
spacingModel.nativeMode: Continues to follow system Dock metrics.

loginStartup.default: Opt-in; settings reads do not register.
loginStartup.pendingApproval: Toggle remains off; explain pending state and offer system-settings/cancel actions.
loginStartup.verificationLimit: Injected state tests do not prove a real logout/login launch.

components.name: Settings navigation
components.description: Native preferences toolbar with four category items, a searchable source list and keyboard navigation.

components.name: Aligned sizing form
components.description: Native size, unified 0–100 artwork spacing, length and position controls; 112 pt label column, 14 pt gap, 81 pt value column.

components.name: Fixed-sample layout example
components.description: Compact card with five stable system-app samples, 75% horizontal/45% vertical scale, responsive preferences and scrollable overflow. No live-app list or actual-size claims.

components.name: Advanced header
components.description: One 44 pt native button covers chevron, title, status and whitespace; exposes expanded/collapsed state.

components.name: Login startup
components.description: Opt-in system-backed login registration with honest pending approval and error states.

narrative.overview: User-approved November 17 draft implemented in native SwiftUI/AppKit. Semantic macOS colors and system fonts remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Five fixed samples above aligned sizing rows
Unified visible-artwork spacing and explicit per-screen scope
Whole-header advanced disclosure and opt-in login startup

rules.name: Illustrative sample
rules.body: Keep five fixed examples independent from real apps; use orientation-specific fixed scale and clearly label the surface as a layout example.

rules.name: Visible spacing
rules.body: Use 0–100 visible-artwork spacing without cropping or enlarging bitmaps and without silently compressing the requested ratio.

rules.name: Preserve settings
rules.body: Preserve legacy geometry until explicit new-spacing choices, and retain groups, permissions and per-display positions.

rules.name: System startup state
rules.body: Only ServiceManagement enabled status means login startup is on; reading settings never registers the app.

dos: Use native controls and semantic colors.
Check compact, dark, advanced, system-follow, overflow and sample-invariance states.
Distinguish fixture and injected-service checks from real desktop, VoiceOver and login acceptance.
donts: Do not replace native settings with a web view.
Do not infer physical-mouse acceptance from fixtures.
